relationship_to_parent: New source route only. The prior closeout remains immutable. This V0.2 tests a currently documented Tardis free-sample route that was not established in the parent closeout.
scientific_question: Can historical Deribit BTC option-chain snapshots be reconstructed point-in-time with strike/expiry/type/open-interest and contemporaneous option Greek fields sufficient to support a later gamma-exposure source protocol without opening BTC market outcomes?

vendor_source.documented_free_access: First day of each month without API key

retained_metrics_only: download response status and byte/row counts
number of expiries within 14 calendar days
aggregate_gate: All four deterministic probe dates must pass every per-date gate.
scientific_limit: A source PASS establishes historical point-in-time OI/Greek availability only. Aggregate open interest does not by itself identify dealer long/short inventory, so a separate pre-Discovery mechanism authority must adjudicate any dealer-position-sign assumption before BTC outcomes.
commercial_limit: Free monthly samples are not sufficient for the full 2021-2024 Discovery corpus. A PASS may still leave full-history acquisition commercially blocked until separately authorized.
stop_rule: Do not lower field-coverage, snapshot-size, freshness, expiry or year requirements after acquisition. Do not substitute current Deribit chains for historical snapshots.
